fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 4% of combined net service and merchandise revenue from opening until first year anniversary, then 6% thereafter for the remainder of the Franchise Agreement term. Conversion of existing company-owned salon pays 6% for the entire term. Advertising fee is 5% of net monthly service revenue (excluding merchandise) with a potential rebate if 75% of Salons in specific DMA vote in favor. Gift card ACH monthly settlement fee of $10/month per bank account. Anniversary Fee: 1% of total net monthly revenues for 12 months preceding first 10-year anniversary; 2% for each 10-year anniversary thereafter. Transfer Fee: tiered from $2,500 (1 salon) to $7,500 (5 salons), then $500 per additional salon. Lease Renewal Fee: $1,500. Lease Guaranty Fee: amount by which 16% of monthly gross sales exceeds monthly lease payments. Late payment interest: 1.5%/month or highest allowable commercial contract rate, plus $100 administrative fee. Construction Management Services Fee: $5,500-$7,500. Construction and Design Plan Review Fee: $500-$1,000. Post Build Review Fee: $1,500-$3,000.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees For new Salons, combined service and merchandise royalty fee is 4% of combined net service revenue and net merchandise revenue from opening date until first year anniversary. From first year anniversary until the Franchise Agreement expires or is terminated, royalty fee is 6% of combined net service revenue and net merchandise revenue.
Advertising Fees 5% of net monthly service revenue (i.e., excluding merchandise sales) with a potential rebate if 75% of Salons in specific DMA vote in favor of rebate
Gift Card Transactions/Processing Fee ACH Monthly Settlement Service Fee of $10/month per Bank Account
Late Payments / Interest / Administrative Fee 1.5% per month or the highest commercial contract interest rate the law allows, whichever is less. In addition, you must pay us a One-Hundred Dollar ($100) administrative fee.
Anniversary Fee 1% of total net monthly revenues for 12 full months immediately preceding first 10 year anniversary. For each 10 year anniversary thereafter, 2% of total net monthly revenues for 12 full months immediately preceding such anniversary date.
Transfer Fee 1 salon $2,500 / 2 salons $4,500 / 3 salons $6,000 / 4 salons $7,000 / 5 salons $7,500 / Each salon after is $500
Lease Renewal Fee $1,500
Lease Guaranty Fee The amount by which sixteen percent (16%) of your monthly gross sales exceeds your monthly lease payments
Construction Management Services Fee $5,500 - $7,500
Construction and Design Plan Review Fee $500-$1,000
Post Build Review Fee $1,500-$3,000
